name: Palia – Maji Market
description: The items sold at the Maji Market, by shop. Item list from paliatracker.com.

items.name: Delaila's Halo Halo
items.description:
A shaved ice treat topped with mix [sic] of fruit, jelly, and condensed milk. Say hello to an explosion of flavor. Sold at Delaila's Sweet Treats.
Delaila's Sweet Treats • 500 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Delaila's Handy Crepe
items.description:
A thin pancake with fruit and cream. Turn the cone upside-down and put it on your head for a cute, if sticky, hat. Sold at Delaila's Sweet Treats.
Delaila's Sweet Treats • 400 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Delaila's Tanghulu
items.description:
Strawberries in a thick, candy coating. Can also be made with hawthorn. Sold at Delaila's Sweet Treats.
Delaila's Sweet Treats • 150 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Delaila's Spiced Sweet Roll
items.description:
Pastry rolled with Delaila's sweet spice mix. Her secret ingredient is joy. Sold at Delaila's Sweet Treats.
Delaila's Sweet Treats • 150 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Delaila's Rolled Ice Cream
items.description:
Rolls of ice cream topped with even more treats. Worth the brain freeze! Sold at Delaila's Sweet Treats.
Delaila's Sweet Treats • 150 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Delaila's Peach Cake
items.description:
Soft sponge cake shaped and flavored like a peach. Sold at Delaila's Sweet Treats.
Delaila's Sweet Treats • 300 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Delaila's Melon Bun
items.description:
A sweet bun with crisp topping [sic]. Does not contain melon, just looks like one. Sold at Delaila's Sweet Treats.
Delaila's Sweet Treats • 300 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Delaila's Hopalong Puff
items.description:
Soft and sweet, just like a real hopalong! And so light and fuffy, it might float right to the moons. Sold at Delaila's Sweet Treats.
Delaila's Sweet Treats • 400 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Maji Market Bloom Lantern
items.description:
When plants absorb Flow-infused water, they often begin to glow. They can then be harvested to make organic lanterns.
Delaila's Sweet Treats • 2,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Maji Market Springblossom Vase
items.description:
These Palian trees only blossom for a few weeks in spring, but branches can last much longer inside with a little love and care.
Delaila's Sweet Treats • 3,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Maji Market Ormuu Standee
items.description:
If you're too afraid to take your picture with a real ormuu, you can use this standee to recreate the experience. 100% manure free!
Delaila's Sweet Treats • 5,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Reth's Bánh Mì
items.description:
Cold cuts and pickled veggies in an airy roll. Inspired by a sandwich Reth once found by a waterfall. Sold at Reth's Street Specialties.
Reth's Street Specialties • 250 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Reth's Corn Dogs
items.description:
Corn-battered, deep-fried sausages. Food always tastes better on a stick. Sold at Reth's Street Specialties.
Reth's Street Specialties • 150 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Reth's Hearty Veggie Bao
items.description:
Just like soup! But in dumpling form. Very juicy, so remember a napkin! Sold at Reth's Street Specialties.
Reth's Street Specialties • 200 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Reth's Hot Peki Wings
items.description:
Battered, fried, peki wings shaken in a secret spice mix. Feel the burn! Sold at Reth's Street Specialties.
Reth's Street Specialties • 200 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Reth's Ice Cream Mochi
items.description:
A scoop of ice cream wrapped in mochi. An adorable collaboration between Reth and Delaila. Sold at Reth's Street Specialties.
Reth's Street Specialties • 350 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Reth's Onigiri
items.description:
Rice balls stuffed with various secret and potentially questionable fillings. Each one is a surprise! Sold at Reth's Street Specialties.
Reth's Street Specialties • 250 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Reth's Poke Bowl
items.description:
Fresh fish marinated in spices and served on a bed of seasoned rice. A Kilima take on an Inyrevn classic. Sold at Reth's Street Specialties.
Reth's Street Specialties • 500 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Reth's Red Bean Mochi
items.description:
Glutinous rice balls filled with sweet, red bean paste. Soft and chewy when fresh. Sold at Reth's Street Specialties.
Reth's Street Specialties • 400 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Reth's Stinky Tofu
items.description:
Fermented tofu that tastes better than it smells. Promise. Sold at Reth's Street Specialties.
Reth's Street Specialties • 150 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Maji Market Woven Basket
items.description:
A lightweight basket made from woven strips of bamboo. Could theoretically double as a very large steamer.
Reth's Street Specialties • 2,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Maji Market Veggie Lantern
items.description:
Assortment of paper lanterns shaped like crops. Caution: may convince impressionable people that vegetables are too cute to eat.
Reth's Street Specialties • 4,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Simple Chapaa Balloon
items.description:
Perfect for a chapaa-themed birthday party, general celebration, or "anniversary of the time I accidentally introduced an invasive species to the local village" day!
Chapaa Tchotchkes • 1,500 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Striped Chapaa Balloon
items.description:
A balloon for the discerning chapaa enthusiast, who doesn't want the pomp and circumstance of a massive chapaa, but won't settle for the simplicity of the original.
Chapaa Tchotchkes • 2,500 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Azure Chapaa Balloon
items.description:
Its cute looks might deceive you, but this chapaa balloon is just as mischievous as the real thing. Keep a tight hold on that string, or it'll float away!
Chapaa Tchotchkes • 4,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Maji Market Nameplate
items.description:
Share your love for tasty food and nightly minigames with this Maji Market themed nameplate!
Chapaa Tchotchkes • 6,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Maji Market Arch
items.description:
Welcome visitors with this lantern-lit archway. Your neighbors will be jealous that they have ordinary doors that actually require opening.
Chapaa Tchotchkes • 6,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Maji Market Dragon Fan
items.description:
An elegant wall fan that sparkles like the night sky, a type of decoration that dates back to the nobility before the Palian Republic.
Chapaa Tchotchkes • 1,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Fine Arrow
items.description:
A regular arrow that deals high damage.
Chapaa Tchotchkes • x20 = 5 Hunting Medal

items.name: Makeshift Arrow
items.description:
A simple arrow that deals low damage.
Chapaa Tchotchkes • x5 = 20 Gold

items.name: Chapaa Pop
items.description:
Ice cream inspired by a chapaa's adorable face. Eat the eyes first before they fall out. Sold at Chapaa Hut.
Chapaa Hut • 50 Gold

items.name: Chapaa Hut Chapaa Mug
items.description:
Enjoy any drink, hot or cold, from this ceramic chapaa head. Best suited to Chapaa Hut's line of carbonated beverages.
Chapaa Hut • 560 Gold

items.name: Chapaa Hut Bahari Board
items.description:
Blast down the beach fast as a chapaa on your busted new Bahari Board. Perfect for rebellious teens and those seeking to reclaim their youth.
Chapaa Hut • 5,160 Gold

items.name: Maji Market No Hunt Sign
items.description:
Make a statement with this anti-hunting sign, which might be a little anti-Hassian too. Chapaas are friends, not food!
Chapaa Hut • 2,000 Gold

items.name: Maji Market Hourglass Drum
items.description:
An hourglass drum that can be played with a mallet or your hands. The different sides represent different elements coexisting in harmony.
Chapaa Chase Prizes • 3,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Maji Market Cart
items.description:
Show off your entrepreneurial spirit with your very own Maji Market cart! If Kenli can run a chapaa petting zoo, then you, too, can sell anything.
Chapaa Chase Prizes • 4,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Maji Market Moon Banner
items.description:
A banner that commemerates the Maji Market. So transcendently beautiful, your friends will think you hung the moons!
Chapaa Chase Prizes • 2,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Maji Market Folding Screen
items.description:
A delicate room divider made from transluscent paper, inspired by the shadow puppet plays that were once popular at Maji Market.
Chapaa Chase Prizes • 1,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Maji Market Chapaa Standee
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to make believe that you're an invasive species? Now you can!
Chapaa Chase Prizes • 5,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Dragon Firework
items.description:
A magical firework that creates a majestic, living trail inspired by Maji the Dragon.
Maji Market Fireworks • 2,000 Maji Market Ticket
Maji Market Fireworks • 2,000 Lucky Envelope

items.name: Blue Waterfall Firework

A dazzling firework that creates a cascade of blue lights that fall through the sky.
Maji Market Fireworks • 250 Maji Market Ticket
Maji Market Fireworks • 250 Lucky Envelope

items.name: Phoenix Firework

A magical firework that creates a bright, living explosion inspired by Embra the Phoenix.
Recipe sold at Maji Market Fireworks

items.name: Zeki's Original Taiyaki
items.description:
The only thing better than cake is a cake shaped like a fish. Sold at Zeki's Lucky Express. [sic]
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 200 Maji Market Ticket
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 200 Lucky Envelope

items.name: Zeki's Ube Taiyaki
items.description:
The only thing better than a cake shaped like a fish, is one with a rich and nutty ube filling. Yum! Sold at Zeki's Lucky Express. [sic]
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 200 Maji Market Ticket
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 200 Lucky Envelope

items.name: Zeki's Custard Taiyaki
items.description:
The only thing better than a cake shaped like a fish, is one with a sweet custard filling. Yum! Sold at Zeki's Lucky Express. [sic]
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 200 Maji Market Ticket
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 200 Lucky Envelope

items.description:

Zeki's Lucky Catch • 200 Maji Market Ticket
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 200 Lucky Envelope

items.name: Zeki's Spicy Taiyaki
items.description:
The only thing better than a cake shaped like a fish, is one with a spicy hot filling. Yum! Sold at Zeki's Lucky Express. [sic]
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 225 Maji Market Ticket
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 200 Lucky Envelope

items.name: Maji Market Basket
items.description:
A low, handwoven basket perfect for displaying food, whether it's freshly toasted bread buns or glossy ripe apples.
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 2,000 Maji Market Ticket
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 2,000 Lucky Envelope

items.name: Maji Market Human Standee
items.description:
This is just a standee of a regular Human. It's unclear why you'd want to pretend to be a perfectly normal Human, but for some reason it's been placed in the Maji Market anyways.
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 5,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Starry Evening Wallpaper
items.description:
This lovely wallpaper matches the starry sky outside. For approximately one hour in the evening. If it's clear.
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 2,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Leaning Bamboo Wallpaper
items.description:
Step into the serenity of a remote bamboo grove with this immersive wallpaper, which will wrap any space in a peaceful quiet.
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 2,000 Maji Market Ticket
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 2,000 Lucky Envelope

items.name: Tranquil Waves Wallpaper
items.description:
Stare at this tranquil wallpaper long enough, and you'll begin to hear the crashing of waves along the shore and taste the sea on your lips.
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 2,000 Maji Market Ticket
Zeki's Lucky Catch • 2,000 Lucky Envelope

items.name: Li'l Carrot
items.description:
Ignore the teeth marks, the li'l sernuk mistook this li'l plush for a real carrot. Thankfully, he's well made and can stand up to even the chompiest toddlers!
Zeki's Claw Machine • 1 Claw Machine Token

items.name: Li'l Beetle
items.description:
He's a little confused about how he ended up in this claw machine, but he's got the spirit. Maybe you can give this li'l beetle a new home?
Zeki's Claw Machine • 1 Claw Machine Token

items.name: Li'l Snail
items.description:
This li'l guy might be slow, but he'll zoom his way into your heart and your home. Just keep him away from any stray salt shakers.
Zeki's Claw Machine • 1 Claw Machine Token

items.name: Li'l Froggy
items.description:
You've heard of Giga Frogbert, now get ready for... this li'l guy. Not nearly as towering, but he takes up just as much space in our hearts.
Zeki's Claw Machine • 1 Claw Machine Token

items.name: Li'l Sernuk
items.description:
Most sernuk turn tail and run when people approach, but not THIS li'l guy. He'll run right into your arms, so make sure to hug him tight!
Zeki's Claw Machine • 1 Claw Machine Token

items.name: Li'l Turnip
items.description:
We're so glad to see you TURNIP! A party's always better with this li'l guy on the scene. At least, Badruu certainly thinks so.
Zeki's Claw Machine • 1 Claw Machine Token

items.name: Chapaa Hut Fun Guy Plush
items.description:
This huggable chapaa plush is holding an equally cuddly mushroom, and he's ready to have a good time with his new friend: you!
Chapaa Chase Prizes • 1,200 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Chapaa Hut Embra Plush
items.description:
Inspire a budding historian with this bright plushie of Embra, the Phoenix! Sure to keep you warm at night.
Chapaa Hut • 19,000 Gold

items.name: Chapaa Hut Maji Plush
items.description:
Bless your home with this cozy plushie of Maji, the Dragon! Be soothed by its soft presence.
Chapaa Hut • 60,000 Gold

items.name: Chapaa Hut Inki Plush
items.description:
Bring Inki, the mischevious [sic] chapaa, home with you! Easier to care for than an actual chapaa.
Chapaa Chase Prizes • 1,500 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Chapaa Hut Naanshi Plush
items.description:

items.name: Chapaa Hut Mini Maji Plush
items.description:
Legends say that Maji was a fiery youth, with scales as bold and bright as his personality. This tiny plush embodies all of that and more!
Chapaa Chase Prizes • 8,000 Maji Market Ticket
Chapaa Chase Prizes • 8,000 Lucky Envelope

items.name: Chapaa Hut Pillow
items.description:
Can't pick a favorite chapaa? Take home this pillow, and you can pretend it's all of them at the same time.
Chapaa Tchotchkes • 900 Maji Market Ticket
Chapaa Chase Prizes • 900 Lucky Envelope

items.name: Chapaa Hut Inki Pillow
items.description:
A pillow modeled after the adventurous chapaa, Inki. Not great for your back, but it sure is cute!
Chapaa Tchotchkes • 1,000 Maji Market Ticket

items.name: Makeshift Chapaa Hide Rug
items.description:
Real chapaa would be too small to make a good carpet, so someone made this scaled-up replica.
Chapaa Hut • 1,240 Gold

items.name: Makeshift Garden Chapaa
items.description:
Tired of basic planters? This one's cute AND chapaa-shaped! Liven up your garden with one... or fifty of these. The more, the merrier!
Chapaa Hut • 2,360 Gold

items.name: Chapaa Onigiri
items.description:
A perfectly formed rice ball made to conveniently fit into any Palian's pockets.
Recipe sold at Reth's Street Specialties

items.name: Poke Bowl

A colorful Maji Market delicacy of raw fish, vegetables, and spices. Popular in Inyrevn due to the region's abundance of fresh seafood.
